'''Vibroaxe Squadron''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] lead by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Unidentified Vibroaxe Prime|Vibroaxe Prime]]. They participated in [[Zsinj]]'s [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|raid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] but suffered heavy [[Starship/Legends|vehicle]] and personnel losses.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
